title: An Algorithm for the Machine Calculation of Complex Fourier Series
lineage: Paper reports 17 August 1964 receipt, earlier work by Good, and partial sponsorship of Princeton research by Army Research Office (Durham). Its IBM 7094 timing table reports 0.04 minutes for 16 × 16 × 16 and 0.07 minutes for 4096 × 1 × 1 arrays.
